name: Iijima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iijima town emblem in white and light blue: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a small ring, within a wreath of leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Iijima, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.
